log_type: Retrospective factual access summary; exact request timestamps are not asserted.

entries.result_and_gap: Full text not acquired; no additional write timing extracted.

entries.result_and_gap: 56 us/cell belongs to a projected integrated controller, not the measured external control setup. Continuous target weights lack a defined b_R codebook.

entries.result_and_gap: Pulse-count speedup, not absolute write-ready time. 16-state tolerance data do not establish pulse/verify durations; 4.31/4.67 speed values differ in the article.
